description: This is a PHP source file that defines the EmployeeDependentAPI class, which extends the Endpoint class and implements CRUD operations for managing employee dependents within an HRM system. The class includes methods to get, list, create, update, and delete employee dependents, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for API documentation. It interacts with the EmployeeDependentService and related models to perform these operations.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for employee dependents, including methods to get, list, add, update, and delete dependents, supported by validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetch a single employee dependent based on employee number and dependent ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: List all dependents of a specified employee, supporting filtering and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Add a new dependent for an employee.

methods.name: saveEmpDependent
methods.description: Internal method to create or update an EmpDependent object from request data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the common body parameters used in create and update operations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing employee dependent based on provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Remove dependents for a specific employee based on provided IDs.
